scripts.lint: ESLINT_USE_FLAT_CONFIG=false eslint src tools tests build --ext .ts,.tsx
scripts.lint:fix: ESLINT_USE_FLAT_CONFIG=false eslint src tools tests build --ext .ts,.tsx --fix
scripts.test:seedfinder:smoke: bun test tests/extractors/web.test.ts -t "SeedFinder full profile smoke"
scripts.test:quality:headless: bun run typecheck && bun run test:seedfinder && bun run test:seedfinder:smoke && bun run test:e2e:headless
scripts.verify:taskpad:intake: bun run typecheck && bun run taskpad:queue-health --
scripts.verify:taskpad:intake:full: sh -c 'set -e; taskpad=""; plan=""; while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; do case "$1" in --taskpad) taskpad="$2"; shift 2 ;; --plan) plan="$2"; shift 2 ;; *) shift ;; esac; done; bun run typecheck; bun run taskpad:queue-health -- --taskpad "$taskpad"; bun run taskpad:planned-command-parity -- --taskpad "$taskpad" --plan "$plan" --package package.json; bun run taskpad:fallback-artifact-parity -- --taskpad "$taskpad" --plan "$plan"; bun run taskpad:verification-pack -- --taskpad "$taskpad" --plan "$plan" --out docs/quality/taskpad-verification-pack.json --history docs/quality/taskpad-verification-pack-history.ndjson; bun run taskpad:verification-pack-contract -- --taskpad "$taskpad" --plan "$plan" --pack docs/quality/taskpad-verification-pack.json --history docs/quality/taskpad-verification-pack-history.ndjson --package package.json; bun run taskpad:verification-pack-execution-gate -- --taskpad "$taskpad" --plan "$plan" --pack docs/quality/taskpad-verification-pack.json --package package.json; bun run plan:integrity -- --plan "$plan"' --
scripts.verify:taskpad:intake:auto: sh -c 'set -e; taskpad=""; plan=""; while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; do case "$1" in --taskpad) taskpad="$2"; shift 2 ;; --plan) plan="$2"; shift 2 ;; *) shift ;; esac; done; if bun run taskpad:queue-health -- --taskpad "$taskpad" --format json 2>&1 | grep -q '"QH001_EXECUTABLE_QUEUES_EMPTY"'; then bun run taskpad:auto-ideation -- --taskpad "$taskpad" --plan "$plan" --target-queue work; fi; archive="docs/archive/TASKPAD_ARCHIVE_$(date +%Y-%m).md"; bun run taskpad:execution-queue-prune -- --taskpad "$taskpad" --archive "$archive"; bun run taskpad:execution-queue-archive-parity -- --taskpad "$taskpad" --archive "$archive"; bun run taskpad:work-queue-prune -- --taskpad "$taskpad" --archive "$archive"; bun run taskpad:work-queue-archive-parity -- --taskpad "$taskpad" --archive "$archive"; bun run taskpad:evidence-gap-refresh-contract-parity -- --taskpad "$taskpad" --plan "$plan" --project-root . --format json; bun run taskpad:knowledge-revalidation-refresh-contract-parity -- --taskpad "$taskpad" --plan "$plan" --project-root . --format json; bun run verify:taskpad:intake:full -- --taskpad "$taskpad" --plan "$plan";' --
scripts.test:full: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun test
scripts.ci:full: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun test
